ns2:course.label: New Scandinavian Cinema
ns2:course.description: Represents the breadth and critical importance of contemporary Scandinavian film culture and cinema practices. Significant themes, movements, and production features will be addressed, including transnational and minority filmmaking and the international export of Scandinavian film. Also provides an introduction to contemporary Scandinavian culture. All materials in English. Same as MACS 492.
